🔗 Related: Multivest"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> **Multi-agent debate framework for academic research.**
> Instead of one AI writing a literature r"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"eview for you — an AI team interviews you, debates each claim across methodological perspectives, re"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"aches consensus via dynamic mathematical convergence, and verifies every citation against source abs"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"tracts and full texts."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## ❓ Why Not Just Ask ChatGPT or Elicit?"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"A single LLM produces confident-sounding answers with no cross-validation — hallucinations slip thro"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ugh, conflicting perspectives get flattened, and you cannot tell which conclusions are robust vs. sp"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"icting perspectives get flattened, and you cannot tell which conclusions are robust vs. speculative."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Consensus Pipeline replaces one-shot generation with **structured multi-agent debate as a quality ga"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"te**: every claim is challenged by independent "departments," contradictions are surfaced explicitly"},{"id":"p7s3","text":", and final conclusions carry **per-claim confidence annotations** (e.g., `"42/77 papers, high confi"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"al conclusions carry **per-claim confidence annotations** (e.g., `"42/77 papers, high confidence"`)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Dimension | Single LLM (ChatGPT) | Elicit / Consensus.app | **Consensus Pipeline** |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| **Core Mechanism** | One-shot generation | Single-pass extraction | **11-Department Adversarial De"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"bate** |
| **Stopping Rule** | Single turn | Fixed top-$k$ retrieval | **Dynamic Convergence ($CV$ +"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" Kendall's $W$)** |
| **Contradictions** | Flattened / averaged out | Listed side-by-side | **Cross-"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"examined across methodological perspectives** |
| **Citation Audit** | Hallucination-prone | Abstrac"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"t snippet match | **2-Stage NLI (Abstract + Full-Text) & Mismatch Tagging** |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## 📸 What It Looks Like"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Step 1: Requirement Interview
The pipeline starts by interviewing you — an AI agent asks clarify"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ing questions to understand your research scope, constraints, and goals."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## 🎯 Core Capabilities"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**The pipeline in one sentence:** Search papers → 3-layer QC filter → 11 departments debate each cla"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"im → cross-department validation → generate confidence-annotated report with NLI citation verificati"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"→ cross-department validation → generate confidence-annotated report with NLI citation verification."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- 🔍 **Multi-Source Paper Search & 3-Layer QC** — Queries OpenAlex + Semantic Scholar + arXiv with au"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"tomatic deduplication, followed by a `hard_filter → LLM_classify → tag_layer` sieve (~65% off-topic "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"exclusion rate).
- 🏛️ **11-Department Adversarial Debate** — 2–4 specialized debaters per department"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" with cross-department consensus handoff (eliminating isolated debate silos) and dynamic convergence"},{"id":"p14s5","text":" ($CV$ + Kendall's $W$).
- 📊 **Per-Claim Confidence & Faithful Paraphrase** — Every conclusion is ta"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"gged with supporting paper counts; strict transcription rules prevent fabricated data levels or mech"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"anism directions.
- ✅ **Two-Stage NLI Citation Verification** — Every claim is checked against retri"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"eved abstracts and full texts, explicitly distinguishing **citation mismatch (⚠️ wrong paper)** from"},{"id":"p14s9","text":" **overstatement (✂️ wording too strong)** while excluding unverifiable claims (📖 needs-fulltext / 📭"},{"id":"p14s10","text":" title-only) from polluting confidence scores.
- 📄 **Full-Text Breakpoint & Multi-Format Export** — "},{"id":"p14s11","text":"Auto-fetches OA full texts (Unpaywall/S2/OpenAlex), pauses at Phase 5.5 for interactive paywalled PD"},{"id":"p14s12","text":"F supplementation, and exports bilingual reports (Markdown / DOCX / PDF) plus runnable Python code."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"📋 Click to expand the complete 18-point technical feature checklist"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- ✅ Multi-source paper search (OpenAlex + Semantic Scholar + arXiv)
- ✅ 3-layer QC: hard filter → LL"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"M classify → importance tagging (219 → 77 papers, ~65% exclusion)
- ✅ 10–11 debate departments, each"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" with 2–4 debaters arguing from different perspectives
- ✅ Multi-round debate with **dynamic termina"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"tion** — stance quantification ($CV$) + Kendall's $W$ agreement
- ✅ Cross-department validation (one"},{"id":"p16s5","text":" department audits another's conclusions)
- ✅ Per-claim confidence annotation (e.g., `"42/77 papers,"},{"id":"p16s6","text":" high confidence"`)
